metadata.case_name: KHAN SABZ ALI v. KO KIM DEVELOPMENT COMPANY LIMITED

injuries.description: contusion or sprain injury to the back
source: Dr Lee diagnosed the plaintiff of suffering from a contusion injury of the right thigh, right calf and contusion or sprain injury to the back which was consistent with the mechanism of injury; and that the plaintiff probably suffered from a contusion injury to the soft tissue of right thigh and low back.

manifestations.description: constant pain and burning feeling in the lower back
numbness on knees and left leg (complained by plaintiff)
falls when getting up from sitting because he could not straighten his back; five to six falls during the six-month period prior to this hearing
incapable of lifting weight over 20 - 25 kg (Dr Lee's opinion)
positive flip tests, non-dermatomal impaired sensation and positive simulation tests (non-organic signs raising the suspicion of symptom magnification)

source: He was given analgesics injection and was discharged on the same day with sick leave of 3 days.
As seen from the medical records, he was continuously being treated with medication and was granted sick leave of 438 days in total.He has attended 13 sessions of physiotherapy.
